source_caption:
I'm Gonna Git You Sucka follows Jack Spade, a former soldier who returns to his neighborhood after his brother dies because he was wearing too many expensive gold chains. Determined to bring down the corrupt crime boss responsible for exploiting the community, Jack assembles an eccentric team of retired heroes to fight back.

In I'm Gonna Git You Sucka, the film hilariously spoofs the blaxploitation action movies of the 1970s with exaggerated characters, absurd situations, and sharp satire. Directed by and starring Keenen Ivory Wayans, it blends action and comedy while poking fun at genre clichés, making it a cult classic among parody films.

source_details.title: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka
source_details.synopsis: I'm Gonna Git You Sucka is a 1988 American blaxploitation parody film written, directed by and starring Keenen Ivory Wayans in his directorial debut. Featured in the film are several noteworthy African-American actors who were part of the genre of blaxploitation: Jim Brown, Bernie Casey, Antonio Fargas and Isaac Hayes. It co-stars John Vernon, Kadeem Hardison, Ja'net Dubois, John Witherspoon, Damon Wayans, Clarence Williams III, Dawnn Lewis, and Chris Rock, and acts as the film debuts of comedian Robin Harris and brothers Shawn and Marlon Wayans.
